page.overview:
Who is Radia?

Radia is an Alpha Team minifigure released in 2001 after making her video game debut in 2000.

In the 5714 LEGO Alpha Team PC game, Radia wears a black jumpsuit, with the left side of her torso being colored white and the right side of her torso being colored violet. Her right sleeve is bright violet, and her gloves are grey. Her legs featured pockets and two textured kneepads. She has a white Mini U.S. Cap textured with the Alpha Team logo, and two modeled violet pigtails. Her face is printed with red lipstick, violet eyeliner, violet hair, and a headset with a microphone.

On the box art for LEGO Alpha Team, the black portions of Radia's torso (including her left sleeve) are colored white instead. The title screen of the 5725 LEGO Alpha Team GBC version and the cover of the instruction manual are based upon an older render of Radia, which depicted her with a black shirt, light pink instead of violet, different tools on her belt, no eyeliner, and no logo on her hat. Likely due to being a remnant of this, Radia's uniform color is listed as white instead of purple on the LEGO Alpha Team website.

When Radia made her physical debut in 2001, her minifigure design was based upon her video game model with some changes. Her torso print was given greater detail, including the Alpha Team logo and what appears to be black drawstrings, although one piece of equipment on her belt was changed to a pouch. Her hip also features a bit of violet printing on the right side to continue the pattern from her torso to her leg. However, her right sleeve has been changed from violet to black, her hat no longer sports the Alpha Team logo, and her pigtails have been removed.
